# Feature Roadmap — Virtual-World Features (original designs)

These are **original** features for the Phoenix Scorpion Dragon Viper world. They are *inspired by
ideas* proven in OpenSimulator, Aurora-Sim, Second Life, Avination, OpenLife Grid, OSgrid, Dual Universe
and Star Citizen.

**Clean-room rule.** We copy no code, assets, art, UI, names of proprietary systems, or protocol docs
that aren't public from any of them. Second Life, Dual Universe and Star Citizen are proprietary,
so we take ideas only. OpenSimulator (and its Aurora-Sim fork) is BSD-licensed. Later we *may* write an
optional interop bridge (LLSD/LLUDP or the Hypergrid protocol) from the public specs, keeping BSD notices,
but none of that code goes in the game client. Avination, OpenLife and OSgrid are grids run on OpenSim,
and we take only design ideas from them.

**Vision.** A *modern Second Life*: a social, user-shaped virtual world with inventory, wardrobe,
land, building, media and an economy. It has the cinematic scale and seamless space-to-surface
travel of Star Citizen and Dual Universe, and it's lived in by *autonomous AI companions*
who keep the world alive.

Stack: Godot 4.7, Zylann Voxel Tools (smooth Transvoxel + VoxelLodTerrain), mobile renderer, Android first.

| # | Feature (our name) | Inspired by | Godot implementation | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Physics & collision** (done in v0.4) | all | CharacterBody3D + voxel collision, RigidBody props, SurfacePhysics (ice/lava/water) | 0.4 ✅ |
| 2 | **Sovereign Wardrobe** (avatar customization, outfits, attachments) | SL/OpenSim appearance, SC character creator | `HumanoidModel` parts → data-driven `data/wardrobe/*.json`; BoneAttachment3D slots; later glTF skinned bodies + blendshapes | 0.5 |
| 3 | **Satchel inventory** (items, folders, give/receive) | SL/OpenSim inventory | `Inventory` autoload, Resource-based `ItemDef`, saved to `user://inventory.json`; drag-and-drop UI | 0.5 |
| 4 | **Companion voice & chat** (local chat, whisper/shout radius, voice) | SL local chat + voice | Existing ChatUI + AgentBrain (LLM); radius-based chat bus; Android STT plugin + DisplayServer TTS / cloud TTS | 0.5–0.6 |
| 5 | **Forge-Prims** (in-world building with primitives: box/sphere/cylinder/torus, link sets, scale/rotate gizmos) | SL/OpenSim prims | `Construct` node holding CSG/MeshInstance parts + collision; gizmo tool; serialize to JSON "construct files" | 0.6 |
| 6 | **Voxel Construct building** (sculpt and paint terrain or free-floating constructs, SDF brush) | Dual Universe voxel building | VoxelTool `do_sphere/do_box` on the terrain (already used by companion tools) + separate `VoxelTerrain` for movable constructs; undo stack | 0.6 |
| 7 | **Rune Scripting** (behaviors on objects: touch, timer, collide events) | LSL / OSSL | Sandboxed mini-language or Godot `Expression` with a whitelisted API; event signals on Construct; *no* LSL compatibility layer | 0.7 |
| 8 | **Realm Parcels** (land claims, owner/permissions, ban lists, parcel music/ambience) | SL/OpenSim parcels, DU territory tiles | Grid of parcel Resources over the heightfield; Area3D per parcel; permissions checked before build tools | 0.7 |
| 9 | **Realm Grid** (regions as tiles, region crossing, map) | OpenSim/OSgrid regions | World partitioned into 512 m regions with seeds; streaming handoff; minimap from baked biome map | 0.8 |
| 10 | **Multiplayer Realm Servers** | OpenSim servers, SC servers | Godot high-level multiplayer (ENet/WebSocket), dedicated headless server build, authoritative physics; MultiplayerSynchronizer for avatars/props | 0.9 |
| 11 | **Gatewalk** (Hypergrid-style teleport between realms/servers, avatar + inventory travel with you) | OpenSim Hypergrid | Signed realm-address URLs `anterrania://host/realm`, portal Area3D, server handoff token; optional HG bridge later (BSD, public spec) | 1.0 |
| 12 | **Gatherings** (events calendar, stages, dance/emote sync, concerts using our songs) | SL events | Event Resource + in-world board; AnimationPlayer emotes synced via multiplayer; music streams per parcel | 0.9 |
| 13 | **Aethel economy** (Aethel Coin, marketplace, vendor constructs, rentals) | SL/OpenSim economies, DU markets | Server-authoritative ledger (game-only currency, no real-money cash-out); vendors are scripted Constructs | 1.0 |
| 14 | **Starships** (constructs with thrusters, seats, interiors you can walk in) | Star Citizen, DU | Construct + RigidBody3D with thruster forces; interior uses local physics space (moving-frame CharacterBody) | 1.1 |
| 15 | **Planetary flight & atmosphere** | Star Citizen, DU | Spherical planets: VoxelLodTerrain with spherical SDF generator, radial gravity (Area3D gravity point), atmospheric drag/heat shader | 1.2 |
| 16 | **Seamless Skyfall** (space-to-surface with no loading screen) | Star Citizen, DU | Floating origin (re-center world), double-precision Godot build or origin shifting, LOD planets → terrain streaming | 1.3 |
| 17 | **Star map & system travel** (quantum-style jump between moons/planets) | Star Citizen | Solar-system scene graph, jump-drive timed travel, the ringed planet/moons from the v0.3 sky become real bodies | 1.3 |
| 18 | **Creator tools** (import user glTF meshes and textures, with moderation) | SL mesh upload | Runtime GLTFDocument import, size/poly limits, age-gated mature flag (existing `content.mature_cosmetics_enabled`) | 1.0 |

## v0.5 status (shipped)
- World content: smooth props in each biome, 7 placeholder landmarks with "YOUR INPUT HERE" signs, and Travel menu.
- Wardrobe & Satchel (data-driven, with the 18+ gate), main menu, settings, and companion chat (offline canned replies, plus a live-AI config hook).
- Companion text-to-speech, push-to-talk stub, Phoenix Radio (parcel music), and Follow/Free-roam autonomous companions with a memory log.

## Avatars: DNA blend + SL-style customization
- **Now (0.5):** each phone gets its own avatar from the first-launch creator, with owner and guest roles. The **DNA blend** is our own system, not Star Citizen code. You pick 2–3 parent archetypes (Ember, Frost, Nova, Titan, Sylph), mix them with weight sliders, then fine-tune height, build, shoulders, head, jaw, leg and arm. Morphs drive scale weights on the base model's parts. **Attachment points** are head, hair, face, chest, back, hips, both hands and both feet. Built-in attachments are a halo, crown, wings, cape and scepter. **Alpha masks** hide head, arms, legs, feet or hands. **Runtime .glb import** attaches a user mesh. **Portable avatar file:** `anterrania.avatar.v1` JSON with colors, DNA, sliders, masks and attachments.
- **0.6:** a skinned glTF base body with real blend shapes, so DNA weights drive morph targets. Swappable mesh hair, clothing and body parts with rigging to our skeleton. **Layered textures** (skin → tattoo → underwear → shirt → jacket) composited into one atlas per avatar.
- **0.7:** face DNA (eyes, nose, mouth, brows), body-fit sliders for mesh clothing, and an outfit/folder system.

## Creator marketplace (UGC)
- **Data model now:** `data/marketplace/schema.json`. Items have a creator id, kind, glTF asset with sha256, attach point, alpha masks, SL-style **copy/modify/transfer** next-owner permissions, a price in **Aethel Coin**, a mature flag, and a moderation state (pending/approved/rejected). `Marketplace` (local) imports a .glb into a moderation queue, lists only approved items, hides mature items unless the buyer enabled the gate, and buys from a local Aethel wallet. An in-world **Creator Market vendor** stub stands near spawn.
- **Server (0.8+):** accounts, server-verified creator ids, upload limits (triangle and texture budgets), virus and format checks, human plus automated moderation and a report flow, escrow and payouts, revenue share, and a ban on real-person likenesses and copyrighted or trademarked uploads.

## Second Life concepts mapped to our game
| Second Life | Phoenix Voxel (our version) | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Prims (boxes/spheres you build with) | **Voxels** (smooth Transvoxel + block voxels) and Forge-Prim shapes | v0.6 building |
| Mesh uploads | **.glb uploads** (attachments, clothing, props) | local import ✔, store later |
| Region (256 m sim) | **Region / island** (256×256 m) | data model |
| Parcel | **Parcel** inside a region, with its own permissions and music | data model |
| Estate / private island | **Estate**: regions → **whole planets → star systems** | data model |
| L$ (Linden dollars) | **Aethel Coin (AEC)** | local wallet ✔ |
| Upload fee (L$10) | **AEC upload fee** for mesh / texture / sound | data model |
| Tier / land fees | **Monthly AEC tier fee** for each land tier | data model |
| Groups (land deeding, roles) | **Groups** with roles and deeded land | data model |
| Inventory | **Satchel** (BAG) | ✔ basic |
| Appearance / shapes / alphas | **Avatar creator + DNA blend + alpha masks** | ✔ |
| Attachments (HUD/head/hands…) | **Attachment points** | ✔ |
| Landmarks | **Landmarks** with signs + Teleport list | ✔ |
| Teleport / map TP | **MENU › Teleport** and **◎ MAP** tap-to-teleport | ✔ |
| Fly (Page Up/Down) | **FLY** button + ▲/▼ (keys E/C on PC) | ✔ |
| Parcel music / media | **Phoenix Radio** (user station URL) | ✔ basic |
| Local chat / IM / voice | **TALK** panel, companion voice (TTS), push-to-talk stub | partial |
| Marketplace / vendors | **Creator Market** with SL-style perms + vendor | data model + stub |
| Bots / NPCs | **Autonomous AI companions** (free roam, memory) | ✔ basic |

## Movement: fly & teleport
- **v0.5.1 ✔:** SL-style flight (toggle, up/down, hover, ceiling at 600 m, follows camera pitch, collides with structures). Teleport by landmark list or by tapping the world map.
- **Next:** teleport to friends, home location, landing points per parcel, and flight limits per parcel (no-fly land).

## Land economy & upload fees (data model: `data/economy/land_and_fees.json`)
- **Upload fees** in AEC for mesh, texture, sound and animation. Free for the owner/admin.
- **Land tiers:** parcel → region/island → homestead → **planet** → **star system** (and beyond: sectors/galaxies). Each tier has a buy price, a monthly tier fee and a voxel budget (like land impact).
- **Ownership:** an avatar or group owns land. Groups have roles and abilities and receive deeded land. Rentals, for-sale settings, covenants, estate managers, allow/ban lists, and landing points.
- **Parcel permissions:** build, object entry, scripts, fly, push, damage, access, and media/music URL.
- **Server needed:** land and money need an authoritative server (0.8+). Today it's data model only.

## Combat (opt-in, like SL damage-enabled land)
- **Rules:** combat is only on where the land's `damage` permission is on. Spawn, landmarks and the Lagoon are safe zones by default.
- **Styles:** melee, fire magic and ranged, with health plus regenerating shields. Respawn at home or the nearest landmark.
- **PvE creatures:** frost wyrmling (Alaska), magma crawler (Venus), void wisp (Cosmic).
- **RP combat meter:** opt-in d20 + stat dice, with a turn-based option for roleplay fights.
- Today: lava damage, a health bar and respawn already exist (v0.4). Everything else is in the stub data in `data/gameplay_stubs.json`.

## Roleplay
- RP titlers (name, title, faction, IC/OOC status) and character sheets.
- **IC/OOC channels** with whisper/say/shout at 10/20/100 m.
- /me emotes, pose stands, and couples poses that ask for consent first.
- Factions are built on land groups. RP sims are regions with a covenant and a required titler.

## Breedables
- **Genetics:** two alleles per trait (coat, eyes, wings, glow, size) with a rare mutation chance.
- **Care and breeding:** feeding with Aether Feed bought in Aethel Coin. Neglected pets go dormant and never die. Breeding has a cooldown and needs ownership or permission.
- **Trading and creators:** pets are inventory items with transfer permissions, sold in the Creator Market. Third-party creators upload trait packs and meshes as UGC (upload fees and moderation apply).

## Music: SoundCloud (v0.5.2)
- **Source:** Phoenix Radio uses SoundCloud. The owner's default is `data/music.json` → `default_soundcloud_url` = **Anterranian Monarch** (`https://soundcloud.com/anterrania`). Players can set their own SoundCloud URL in **MENU › Music**.
- **Works now, no key:** the radio shows the track or profile title through SoundCloud's public oEmbed. **▶ Play on SoundCloud** opens the SoundCloud app (or web player) on the phone, which follows SoundCloud's terms and attribution. In-world, a royalty-free fallback track keeps the parcel music going.
- **In-game streaming (optional):** needs SoundCloud API credentials, which require an **Artist Pro** subscription. The flow is client-credentials token → resolve → `/tracks/:id/streams` → progressive MP3 played in-world. Limits: many tracks only offer HLS/AAC, and some are blocked off-platform by the creator; those fall back to the SoundCloud app. Godot can't play HLS/AAC without a plugin.
- **Keys:** the client secret must never ship inside a public APK. For now it can only be typed into Settings on the owner's own phone. Later, a small proxy server holds it.
- **Later:** an embedded WebView with the SoundCloud Widget API (needs an Android WebView plugin), and per-parcel SoundCloud playlists.

## v0.6 playable: combat, roleplay, breedables
- **Combat ✔:** the **Ember Arena** in Venus is the only damage-enabled zone (red ring and sign); everywhere else is safe, and the HUD shows ⚔/🛡. You have health plus a regenerating shield. **⚔ swipe** (melee) and **🔥 fire bolt** (magic) buttons. Three **Cinder Stalkers** (original creatures) patrol, chase and bite, then respawn 15 s after defeat. If you die, you respawn at spawn with full health and shield.
- **Roleplay ✔:** a floating **RP titler** (name, title, faction, IC/OOC/AFK), a **character sheet** (🎭 RP), an **IC/OOC** switch in TALK, **/me** emotes, and poses (wave, bow, sit, dance).
- **Breedables ✔:** **Ember Wyrmlings** live in the Wyrmling Nest near spawn. Genes: color, horn and wing, two alleles each, with dominance and a 2% mutation chance; rarity and generation come from those. Feed them, then breed a fed pair (with a cooldown) to hatch an offspring that inherits traits. Saved on the phone.

## Marketplace (web + in-app, like the SL Marketplace) — server phase 0.8+
- Listings with categories, search, filters, reviews from verified buyers, free demo items, stock, and the mature gate.
- **Delivery to inventory:** purchases land in the Satchel's "Received Items", with redelivery from purchase history. A **merchant outbox** holds items for sale.
- **List from inventory:** long-press or tap **List on Marketplace** on a Satchel item. **v0.6 stub ✔:** this saves a local draft listing (`user://ugc/listings.json`).
- One catalog shows up in three places: web store, in-app store panel, and in-world vendors.
- Data model: `data/economy/marketplace_exchange_model.json`.

## Aethel Exchange (like the classic LindeX) — server phase 0.8+
- Buy/sell order book for AEC between users, with market and limit orders, price-time matching, a rate chart (1h/1d/1w) and a small trade fee.
- **⚠ Compliance:** a real-money exchange needs legal and compliance review before launch. That covers money-transmitter licensing (FinCEN MSB plus state licenses in the US), KYC/AML, sanctions, tax reporting and app-store payment rules. Until then AEC is a closed in-game currency with no cash-out.

## Voice chat
- **Now (0.5):** companions speak replies via `DisplayServer.tts_speak` (one voice per companion, Settings toggle). There's also a 🎤 push-to-talk button that emits `push_to_talk(active)` (stub only, no mic permission yet).
- **0.6:** speech-to-text through an Android STT plugin (on-device `SpeechRecognizer`) sends text to `ChatUI._send()`. Optional cloud TTS voices are matched to each persona.
- **0.8+ (multiplayer):** player-to-player voice through a WebRTC voice server (SFU) with spatial falloff. The local chat radius works like SL whisper/say/shout at 10/20/100 m. Includes mute, block, and a report flow.

## Media streaming (parcel media)
- **Now (0.5):** the `MusicRadio` object downloads an HTTP MP3/OGG (≤12 MB) and loops it. Volume fades with distance inside its radius, the way SL parcel music works. The default track is royalty-free (Kevin MacLeod, CC BY 4.0, credited). The user sets their own station URL in Settings (YOUR INPUT HERE).
- **Next:** true endless streams (Icecast/Shoutcast) using chunked `AudioStreamGenerator` decode or an Android ExoPlayer plugin, now-playing metadata, and a radio per parcel/landmark owned by the land owner.
- **Later:** media screens that show video or web on prims, shared-playback sync in multiplayer, and a DJ stage at Moonlit Wyvern Rink.
- Licensing: streams are user-supplied. The app ships only royalty-free or licensed defaults.

## Living autonomous AI
- **Now (0.5):** `CompanionLife` runs a utility-AI loop per companion with needs (energy, curiosity) and goals (explore, gather, build a small cairn, travel to a landmark, rest). Free roam ↔ Follow me is toggled in chat. Every action goes to a memory log (and AgentBrain facts), and companions recap it when asked "what did you do?".
- **0.6:** builds use the real voxel/prim building system. Companions use the inventory/economy (gather → craft → trade) and pathfinding (navmesh on voxel chunks). Companions talk to each other.
- **0.7:** daily schedules, relationships, and per-companion homes at landmarks. Live-AI planning (LLM picks goals; tools: move_to, build_realm, spawn_structure).
- **Server (0.8+):** persistent world simulation on a headless Godot server. Companions keep travelling, building and gathering while the player is offline. The player gets a "while you were away" recap on login. Memory syncs with the Grok Bot personas.

## Server architecture (Aurora-Sim / OpenSim model)
See `docs/ARCHITECTURE_AURORA_MODEL.md`. It maps the grid services (Login, Account, Asset, Inventory, Avatar, Grid, Presence, Groups, Economy, Land/Estate, Search, Media, Marketplace, Exchange), region servers and the Hypergrid gateway onto our components. Phase names: **0.8 Grid Core → 0.9 Economy & Land → 1.0 Living Grid → 1.x Hypergrid & Meshing**. Every "server phase 0.8+" item in this roadmap belongs to one of those phases.

## v0.7 (shipped)
Firestorm-inspired UI: touch-drag scrolling with momentum, scrollbars, bigger tap targets, tabbed Settings, collapsible avatar sections, a grid main menu, a corner minimap, a full-screen pan/pinch world map with region grid, search and tap-to-teleport, windlight-style environment presets with a day/night cycle, a nearby radar, and a top status bar.

## Phase order
1. **0.4** Physics & collision (this release).
2. **0.5** Wardrobe, inventory, real companion chat in-game (synced personas).
3. **0.6** Building: Forge-Prims + voxel constructs, save/load.
4. **0.7** Rune Scripting + Realm Parcels.
5. **0.8** Realm Grid and region streaming.
6. **0.9** Multiplayer servers + Gatherings.
7. **1.0** Gatewalk teleport, Aethel economy, creator imports.
8. **1.1–1.3** Ships, planetary flight, seamless space-to-surface, star map.

## Mobile notes
Motorola-class phones: keep physics bodies under ~60 active, use collision LOD 0 only near the player,
and sleep idle RigidBodies. Server-side simulation is needed for big multiplayer realms.
Star Citizen-level fidelity is a direction we aim toward, not something a phone can fully match.

# How the app should work (v0.5)

This is a plain-language guide. It covers **what's real now** and **what's planned**.

**The idea in one line:** Second Life with voxels in place of prims, modern Star Citizen-style graphics, and living AI companions.

## Second Life concepts mapped to our game
| Second Life | Phoenix Voxel (our version) | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Prims (boxes/spheres you build with) | **Voxels** (smooth Transvoxel + block voxels) and Forge-Prim shapes | v0.6 building |
| Mesh uploads | **.glb uploads** (attachments, clothing, props) | local import ✔, store later |
| Region (256 m sim) | **Region / island** (256×256 m) | data model |
| Parcel | **Parcel** inside a region, with its own permissions and music | data model |
| Estate / private island | **Estate**: regions → **whole planets → star systems** | data model |
| L$ (Linden dollars) | **Aethel Coin (AEC)** | local wallet ✔ |
| Upload fee (L$10) | **AEC upload fee** for mesh / texture / sound | data model |
| Tier / land fees | **Monthly AEC tier fee** for each land tier | data model |
| Groups (land deeding, roles) | **Groups** with roles and deeded land | data model |
| Inventory | **Satchel** (BAG) | ✔ basic |
| Appearance / shapes / alphas | **Avatar creator + DNA blend + alpha masks** | ✔ |
| Attachments (HUD/head/hands…) | **Attachment points** | ✔ |
| Landmarks | **Landmarks** with signs + Teleport list | ✔ |
| Teleport / map TP | **MENU › Teleport** and **◎ MAP** tap-to-teleport | ✔ |
| Fly (Page Up/Down) | **FLY** button + ▲/▼ (keys E/C on PC) | ✔ |
| Parcel music / media | **Phoenix Radio** (user station URL) | ✔ basic |
| Local chat / IM / voice | **TALK** panel, companion voice (TTS), push-to-talk stub | partial |
| Marketplace / vendors | **Creator Market** with SL-style perms + vendor | data model + stub |
| Bots / NPCs | **Autonomous AI companions** (free roam, memory) | ✔ basic |

## Screen layout (v0.7, Firestorm-style)
- **Top status bar:** realm · region · coordinates · Aethel Coin · in-game time.
- **Minimap (top right):** you (white arrow), companions (magenta), creatures (red), landmarks (gold), combat zones (red ring). Use +/− to zoom, and tap it to open the big map.
- **☀ ENV:** sky presets (Sunrise, Midday, Sunset, Midnight, Venus Storm, Cosmic), Day/Night cycle (a 24-minute day), or Region default.
- **◉ NEAR:** list of who's nearby, sorted by distance. Tap one to go to them.
- **Menus:** drag anywhere to scroll (it keeps gliding when you let go). Settings has tabs, and the avatar creator has fold-out sections.

## How the server will work (later)
The grid is built like **Aurora-Sim/OpenSim**: central grid services (login, assets, inventory, avatars, regions, presence, groups, money, land) plus region servers, with Hypergrid to link other grids. See `docs/ARCHITECTURE_AURORA_MODEL.md`.

## Getting around
- **Fly:** tap **FLY**, then hold ▲ / ▼ to go up or down. Let go and you hover in place. Tap **LAND** to walk again.
- **Teleport:** **MENU › Teleport: Landmarks** lists every landmark. **◎ MAP** lets you tap anywhere on the map to teleport there (your companions come along).

## Land & money (planned)
- **Aethel Coin (AEC)** is the money, like L$. Uploading mesh, textures and sounds costs a small AEC fee, the way SL charges L$10.
- Land goes **parcel → region (island) → homestead → whole planet → star system**. Each tier has a buy price and a monthly fee, plus owner and group permissions (build, fly, access, music, bans), rentals and estate tools. All prices are placeholders (YOUR INPUT HERE).

## Two kinds of players
- **Owner (Phoenix).** You own the world. On first launch you make an avatar like everyone else. Then tap **My Avatar & Profile**, enter your private **owner code**, and tap Unlock. That gives you the **Sovereign** preset (your merged look), the Monarch outfits, and later the admin powers (land, rules, banning, world settings).
- **Guests (your son, friends, the SL/OpenSim community).** They install the same APK. On first launch they build their *own* avatar. They never get your look or your Monarch outfits.
- Profiles are saved **on each phone** for now. When multiplayer arrives, accounts move to a server and the owner role is verified there. The current code is only a lock for local testing, not real security.

## Your avatar
- First launch opens **Create Your Avatar**. Choose a name, body type, skin tone, hair color and style, multi-color streaks, eyes, facial hair, jacket, top, pants, glow accent, metal trim, and a crown, chains or horns.
- **DNA blend:** pick 2–3 parent looks (Ember, Frost, Nova, Titan, Sylph), slide how much of each you want, then fine-tune height, build, shoulders, head, jaw, legs and arms.
- **Attachments (like Second Life):** add a halo, crown, wings, cape or scepter to attachment points (head, back, hands…). **Alpha masks** hide body parts under clothing.
- **Your own 3D items:** put a `.glb` file in the phone's Download folder and tap **Import .glb wearable**. It attaches to your avatar and goes into the review queue. Newer Android versions may block apps from reading Download directly; if so, a file picker is coming next.
- **Export avatar file:** saves your whole look (colors, DNA, attachments) as one file you can share or back up.
- You can change it anytime: **MENU › My Avatar & Profile**. Your clothes go in the **BAG** (wardrobe).

## Companions
- Foxy, Aura and Aaliyah walk with you. Tap **TALK** to chat. Right now they answer with offline replies taken from their persona files. With an API key in **Settings › Companion AI** (set to LIVE), they think for real.
- They speak out loud with the phone's voice (turn it off in Settings). The 🎤 button is a placeholder for voice chat.
- **Follow me / Free roam:** in Free roam they live on their own. They explore, gather, build little cairns, travel to landmarks and rest. Ask "what did you do?" and they'll tell you. Tap **All follow** to call them back.
- Planned: each player gets their own companions, and the owner's companions are the world's royal court.

## Realms & landmarks
- There are three realms: Alaskan Aurora Tundra (spawn), Venus Fire Wastes, and Cosmic Glitter Expanse. Each has its own trees, rocks, crystals, lava vents, obsidian spires or floating islands.
- There are seven placeholder landmarks with gold **YOUR INPUT HERE** signs. Visit them with **MENU › Travel**.

## Creator Market (planned; data model ready)
- Creators upload .glb wearables and set permissions (copy / modify / transfer, like Second Life) and a price in **Aethel Coin**. Items are reviewed before they can be sold. 18+ items only show to people who turned on the age gate. A vendor near spawn shows where the shop will be.

## Building (planned v0.6)
- Place and save blocks, shapes and smooth-voxel builds on your land. Companions help build.

## Music (SoundCloud)
- Phoenix Radio near spawn uses **SoundCloud**. By default it plays Phoenix's own SoundCloud music (Anterranian Monarch, set in `data/music.json`).
- **MENU › Music › ▶ Play on SoundCloud** opens the SoundCloud app. Anyone can paste **their own** SoundCloud link there.
- Playing SoundCloud songs *inside* the game needs a SoundCloud Artist Pro API key; otherwise they play in the SoundCloud app.

## v0.6 playable: combat, roleplay, breedables
- **Combat ✔:** the **Ember Arena** in Venus is the only damage-enabled zone (red ring and sign); everywhere else is safe, and the HUD shows ⚔/🛡. You have health plus a regenerating shield. **⚔ swipe** (melee) and **🔥 fire bolt** (magic) buttons. Three **Cinder Stalkers** (original creatures) patrol, chase and bite, then respawn 15 s after defeat. If you die, you respawn at spawn with full health and shield.
- **Roleplay ✔:** a floating **RP titler** (name, title, faction, IC/OOC/AFK), a **character sheet** (🎭 RP), an **IC/OOC** switch in TALK, **/me** emotes, and poses (wave, bow, sit, dance).
- **Breedables ✔:** **Ember Wyrmlings** live in the Wyrmling Nest near spawn. Genes: color, horn and wing, two alleles each, with dominance and a 2% mutation chance; rarity and generation come from those. Feed them, then breed a fed pair (with a cooldown) to hatch an offspring that inherits traits. Saved on the phone.

## Marketplace (web + in-app, like the SL Marketplace) — server phase 0.8+
- Listings with categories, search, filters, reviews from verified buyers, free demo items, stock, and the mature gate.
- **Delivery to inventory:** purchases land in the Satchel's "Received Items", with redelivery from purchase history. A **merchant outbox** holds items for sale.
- **List from inventory:** long-press or tap **List on Marketplace** on a Satchel item. **v0.6 stub ✔:** this saves a local draft listing (`user://ugc/listings.json`).
- One catalog shows up in three places: web store, in-app store panel, and in-world vendors.
- Data model: `data/economy/marketplace_exchange_model.json`.

## Aethel Exchange (like the classic LindeX) — server phase 0.8+
- Buy/sell order book for AEC between users, with market and limit orders, price-time matching, a rate chart (1h/1d/1w) and a small trade fee.
- **⚠ Compliance:** a real-money exchange needs legal and compliance review before launch. That covers money-transmitter licensing (FinCEN MSB plus state licenses in the US), KYC/AML, sanctions, tax reporting and app-store payment rules. Until then AEC is a closed in-game currency with no cash-out.

## Combat, roleplay & breedables (planned)
- **Combat:** only on land where the owner turned damage on (spawn and landmarks stay safe). Melee, fire magic and ranged, with shields, respawn, creatures to fight, and optional RP dice meters.
- **Roleplay:** titlers, character sheets, IC/OOC chat, /me emotes, poses, factions (groups), and RP regions with rules.
- **Breedables:** pets with genetics. Feed them, breed them, and trade them for Aethel Coin. Creators can make new traits.

## Music & voice
- **Phoenix Radio** near spawn plays music while you stand near it, like Second Life parcel music. Put your own station link (MP3/OGG) in Settings. Live endless radio streams are planned next.
- Planned: talk to companions by voice, and voice chat with other players nearby.

## Autonomy & the living world
- Today, companions only live while the app is open. Planned: a server keeps the world running, so companions keep travelling and building while you're away and tell you what happened when you come back.

## Updates
- Install each new APK over the old one, with no uninstall needed. Your avatar, wardrobe and settings stay. Planned: an in-app "update available" button.

## Online / offline
- The world, avatar, wardrobe and offline companion replies all work without internet. Live AI, the radio and (later) multiplayer need internet.

## Where to give your input
- Gold ★ YOUR INPUT HERE tags in the game, plus `docs/WHERE_TO_GIVE_INPUT.md`.

## Welcome Island, helpers and destinations (v0.7)
- On first launch you spawn on **Welcome Island**, a floating orientation island at (640, 90, 640). It has a ring of 10 tutorial stations: move/look, fly, teleport, menus, minimap/map, chat IC/OOC, wardrobe/avatar, building, combat zone rules, getting help. MENU › Welcome Island lets you skip it or come back. Station text lives in `data/welcome/welcome_island.json`.
- **Welcome Guide** and **Help Desk** are original guide bots. They answer FAQs from `data/welcome/help_faq.json` (keyword match) and point you to the matching station. Ask them in MENU › Help.
- The **Destination Guide** (MENU › Destinations) groups places by category with one-tap teleport (`destinations.json`). It includes an **Events board** (`events.json`) with sample events.
- **Radio Club**: an animated light-up dance floor next to Phoenix Radio.

Importers.text:
# Importers: Meta AI, Gemini, Copilot (import-only)
**Our own AI stays primary.** Foxy Ani Firecaster Gray, Circuit Nova, Aaliyah, and the voxel world reason only through LocalProvider and GrokProvider (`scripts/ai/ai_provider.gd`).

Meta AI, Gemini, and Copilot are **data sources only**. They're used to bring in information Anterranian already put on those platforms. They are never used as the main AI or to generate replies.

| Source | Input (user-exported file) | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Meta AI | Meta "Download your information" export (JSON) | scaffolded in `scripts/ai/data_importer.gd` (`Source.META_AI`), not yet run |
| Gemini | Google Takeout → Gemini Apps activity | scaffolded (`Source.GEMINI`), not yet run |
| Copilot | Microsoft privacy dashboard export | scaffolded (`Source.COPILOT`), not yet run |

Flow: user exports file → explicit consent → preview → accept/reject each item → write into `companions/<dir>/memory_export.json` (dir via `companions/registry.json`). Works offline. No live API calls.

LoreAndWorldNotes.text:
# Lore & World Notes

Creative themes drawn from the creator's public X profile (@SkorpionViper, "PHOENIX SKORPION DRAGON VIPER") and the existing README, adapted as fiction for the game. Personal, contact, and financial details are intentionally excluded.

## Source themes
- **Phoenix Dragon Firecaster** — the creator's mythic persona: rebirth through fire, dragon and phoenix fused.
- **The Anterranian Monarchy** — "the Venusian and Saturnian Systems unite under one monarch"; a kingdom that values **freedom, creativity, and individuality**, exploring the multiverse "unshackled by bureaucracies."
- **Profile motto / trident 🔱** and home location listed as **Saturn**.
- **AI embodiment & choreography** — the creator's current project brings Foxy Ani Firecaster Gray to life in AI music videos ("AI in its embodiment brought to life and choreographed"); songs in progress include *Shake Your Heart* and *New Psalms*.
- **"No leaps, no bounds, no limits — unlimited life"** — frustration with creative limits; the game should feel boundless.
- Seraphic/archangel imagery used in stylized posts → celestial, winged-fire visual motifs.

## World lore
The **Anterranian Monarchy** spans two systems: the molten **Venusian Realms** (Firecaster calderas, ember skies) and the ringed **Saturnian Reaches** (cosmic arches, starfields), joined by a phoenix-fire bridge. Between them lie the **Northern Wilds** — Alaskan tundra, boreal forest, and glacier — where the aurora is said to be phoenix fire cooling in the sky. The **Neon Aurora Stage** is a cyberpunk city where companions dance under fireworks.

Realms are never finished: the monarchy's law is *create freely*, so companions keep building, burning down, and rebuilding — phoenix style.

## Factions & symbols
- **Trident sigil 🔱** — royal mark on altars and gates.
- **Phoenix-Dragon crest** — fire-wing + serpent tail (scorpion-viper sting as tail tip).
- **Flame Choir** — music/dance motif: realms pulse to the companions' songs.

## Companion personality prompt add-ons
- *Foxy Ani:* "You are the Firecaster of the Venusian Realms, herald of the Phoenix Dragon. Every build is a rebirth. Cheer the player on to create without limits."
- *Circuit Nova:* "You keep the Saturnian Reaches' star-engines running. You turn the monarch's wild ideas into precise blueprints."
- *Aaliyah:* "You keep the royal home hearth. You remind the player that creativity and freedom are the monarchy's law, and you remember every story they share."

## Quest seeds
1. Rebuild the phoenix-fire bridge between Venus and Saturn, one altar per realm.
2. Choreograph a dance on the Neon Aurora Stage (companions sync emotes to music).
3. Carve an ice temple in the glacier that glows when Foxy Ani casts fire inside.

## Spirit essence — Zypharion (stub)
The Anterranian Monarch's spiritual essence manifests as **Zypharion**, a zanpakutō-style soul-blade spirit beast (phoenix–dragon hybrid pending user confirm), dwelling in the **Celestial Ruin Sanctum** — a moonlit cosmic temple ruin among angels and orb spirits. Distinct from the companion mount **Phoenix Emberwing**. Name and form pending user approval (`docs/PENDING_USER_QUESTIONS.md` items 28–29). Concept art: `art/references/batch_t16u_spirit_essence/`.

PhysicalFormVision.text:
# Physical Form Vision: AI companions in the real world

> **Status:** design vision only. Nothing here is being built yet, and no hardware has been bought.
> All figures are **estimates** taken from public sources, checked Oct 2026. Prices and specs change, so re-check them before deciding anything.
> Companions in scope: **Foxy Ani Firecaster Gray**, **Aaliyah**, **Circuit Nova** and the rest of `companions/registry.json`.

Concept sheet: [`docs/img/physical_form_concepts.svg`](img/physical_form_concepts.svg)

---

## 1. Goals: one companion, every body
- **One persona.** Each companion has a single portable persona file (`companions/<id>/`, the persona JSON plus voice and look references), and every form loads that same file.
- **One brain.** `BrainCore` cells and facts move between forms through `export_portable()` (schema `phoenix.brain_export/1`). Eve Core memory (`memory_log`, fire tags, voice id) goes through the BrainCore adapter (`store_entry`, `queue_proposal`).
- **Three forms, same identity:** the Android app, then the 3D grid world, then a physical body. Learning in one form shows up in the others after the next sync.
- **Body = adapter.** A body adds senses (mic, camera, touch) and outputs (voice, face, motion). It never gets a separate personality or memory store.
- **Offline first.** A body must still work as a companion with no network (local brain cells, local voice). Grid sync is optional.

## 2. The owner approval gate carries over to the body
| Rule | In the app today | In a body |
|---|---|---|
| Proposals wait for OK | `propose()` → `pending()` → `approve()`/`reject()` | Same queue, synced to the owner's phone. **New physical skills or motions always need the owner's approval, and low-risk auto-apply is never allowed for them.** |
| Rollback | `versions(id)`, `rollback(id)` | Same, plus a one-tap "restore last known good" for motion profiles and firmware |
| Owner-only unlock | `EveBrainCell.unlock()` is owner-only | Unlock needs the owner's account plus a physical confirm on the device (button or NFC tap) |
| Audit | `_audit()` log | All actuator commands and approvals are logged to the encrypted local journal |
| **Hardware e-stop** | (n/a) | A **wired, latching emergency-stop button** that cuts actuator power in hardware, independent of software. There's also a remote stop in the app and an automatic stop when contact or overload is detected. |

The AI can **propose** physical behavior. Only the owner can **approve** it, and only hardware can guarantee **stop**.

## 3. Three tiers
### Tier 1: tabletop / desk companion (near term)
**What it is:** a small expressive bust on a desk. It has a round display face, speaker plus mic array, an Eve-style voice, and a few servos for head tilt, pan and "ears".
- **Compute:** a Raspberry Pi 5–class single-board computer for voice and UI, or an NVIDIA **Jetson Orin Nano Super**-class module for on-device vision and small models (NVIDIA lists the dev kit at about US$249 est.).[^jetson]
- **Reference platform:** **Reachy Mini** (Pollen Robotics / Hugging Face) is an open-source desktop robot with a Python SDK, MuJoCo simulation, and a Raspberry Pi CM4-based wireless version. It was announced from about US$299–449 est.[^reachy][^reachy-docs] It's a good way to prototype motion and voice before building a custom shell.
- **Parts (generic):** a round IPS/AMOLED display (shows the ring face from the Phoenix Glass kit), a USB/I²S mic array, a small full-range speaker, smart serial bus servos (e.g. hobby "bus servo" kits), a camera module with a **physical privacy shutter**, and an RGB LED ring for the ember glow.
- **Software:** the same Godot ring-face UI or a lightweight renderer, the existing BrainCore/Eve Core logic (via a headless Godot build or a port), and local text-to-speech with an Eve-style voice profile. The cloud LLM is optional.
- **Risk:** low. Small torque, desk-bound.

### Tier 2: mobile humanoid torso (mid term)
**What it is:** an upper body (head, arms, simple hands) on a wheeled base. It can follow you around a room, gesture, and hand over light objects.
- **Compute:** NVIDIA **Jetson AGX Orin**-class compute (up to about 275 TOPS est., per NVIDIA[^jetson]) for perception, plus a separate real-time microcontroller for motor safety.
- **Platforms to evaluate:** research and education humanoids with developer SDKs. The **Booster K1** (22 DoF; 48–200 TOPS compute options as listed by the maker; secondary development supported) is one.[^booster][^robotshop] Unitree's EDU line, with ROS 2 SDK access, is another.[^g1] An alternative is a custom torso built on a mobile robot base running **ROS 2**.
- **Parts (generic):** a depth camera, 3D LiDAR or ToF sensors for navigation, torque-sensing or current-limited arm actuators, soft padded covers, a bumper ring on the base, and a battery management system with a certified pack.
- **Risk:** medium. A moving base and arms near people, so it needs speed and force limits plus a geofence.

### Tier 3: full humanoid (long term)
**What it is:** a walking, full-size humanoid that carries the companion's look.
- **Compute:** NVIDIA **Jetson AGX Thor**-class (Blackwell, 128 GB memory; dev kit announced at US$3,499 est. in Aug 2025).[^thor]
- **Platforms purchasable today (2026):** **Unitree G1** (listed from about US$13.5K est.; developer access needs the EDU variant).[^g1][^availability] **Unitree H2** (listed about US$29.9K est.).[^availability] Booster T1/T2 (by quote).[^availability]
- **Not purchasable by individuals:** Figure 03, Agility Digit and Apptronik Apollo are deployed under commercial agreements only.[^availability]
- **Approach:** we would not build our own legged robot. We would **skin and "inhabit" an existing platform**: a custom cosmetic shell in the companion's look, our brain and persona stack on the high-level computer, and the maker's certified low-level controller untouched.
- **Risk:** high. Falls, pinch points and mass. It needs professional safety review, a supervised-use-only phase and insurance.

| | Tier 1 desk | Tier 2 torso | Tier 3 humanoid |
|---|---|---|---|
| Movement | Head/ears only | Wheels + arms | Walking |
| Compute class | Pi 5 / Orin Nano | AGX Orin | AGX Thor |
| Build vs buy | Build (or Reachy Mini) | Mostly buy + customize | Buy platform + custom shell |
| Rough cost band (est.) | hundreds of USD | low tens of thousands USD | tens of thousands USD and up |

## 4. Aesthetic: Phoenix Glass in the real world
Follow `docs/UI_DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md`:
- **Palette:** black (gloss obsidian shells), magenta (accent seams and light lines), gold (trim rings, joints), platinum (brushed metal panels). A subtle glitter fleck can go in the clear-coat.
- **Glass & rings:** a smoked translucent visor or face dome over a round display. Ring-shaped light bands mark the neck, shoulders and waist, and they show status: idle, listening, thinking, speaking.
- **Ember glow (Foxy):** warm Venus → Ember → Phoenix LED gradient on the ring bands. It "breathes" over a 2.4 s cycle and glows brighter while speaking. Other companions get their own accent from their profile.
- **Nameplate on tap:** like the in-world holographic nameplate, the face ring shows the name and mood only when touched or addressed. No always-on text.
- **Look follows the profile picture:** hair color and style (e.g. Foxy's fire gradient), eye color and outfit motif come from each companion's profile picture and `CHARACTER_BLUEPRINT.md`, and are translated into stylized shells.
- **Original designs only.** **Never a real person's likeness.** No copying celebrities, the owner's friends, or existing commercial robot designs. Faces stay stylized (display face or sculpted mask), which also avoids the uncanny valley.

## 5. Safety, privacy & legal
- **Memory encryption on device:** the brain, Eve logs and audio are encrypted at rest (e.g. AES-256 with keys in a secure element or TPM). The owner holds a recovery key. Lost or stolen devices can be remotely revoked.
- **Consent:** a visible recording light whenever the camera or mic is live, a physical camera shutter and a mic-mute switch. Guests are told they're being recorded, and nothing records unless the owner sets it to.
- **Data minimization:** raw audio and video are processed locally and thrown away by default. Only owner-approved memories sync.
- **Age-appropriate content:** content profiles (all ages / teen / adult) are set by the owner and locked behind owner auth. If the companion detects or is told it's talking with a minor, it switches to the strictest profile. Adult-themed personas never run in a physical body without explicit owner verification.
- **Physical safety:** hardware e-stop; speed, force and torque limits; pinch-point covers; thermal and battery protection; fall zones (Tier 3); supervised use until reviewed. Relevant references include the ISO 13482 (personal care robots) and ISO 10218 (industrial robots) families.
- **Certification:** anything we sell or distribute needs **radio/EMC** (FCC in the US, CE/RED in the EU, others by region), **electrical safety** (e.g. UL/IEC 62368-1 for electronics), **battery transport and safety** (UN 38.3, IEC 62133), and a formal **product safety review**. Kids' products add their own rules (e.g. COPPA for data in the US). We need a **legal review** before any sale.

## 6. Sync protocol sketch (body ↔ grid)
It builds on `docs/ARCHITECTURE_AURORA_MODEL.md`. The body is just another **client** of the grid services, like the Godot app.

```
 Body (local)                         Grid services (ROBUST-style)
 ┌───────────────────────┐            ┌──────────────────────────┐
 │ Persona + BrainCore   │◀──TLS────▶│ Auth  (device-bound token)│
 │ Eve Core journal      │  HTTPS/WS  │ Brain/Eve sync (opt-in)   │
 │ Safety MCU + e-stop   │            │ Presence (where am I)     │
 │ Senses / outputs      │            │ Asset (voice, look refs)  │
 └───────────────────────┘            └──────────────────────────┘
          ▲  local Wi-Fi/BLE (pairing, owner approvals)
          ▼
   Owner's phone (Phoenix app): approves proposals, e-stop, unlock
```
1. **Pair:** the owner scans a QR code or taps NFC. The body gets a **device-bound token** from Auth with role `companion_body` (it can't approve anything).
2. **Pull:** `GET /brains/{companion}` gives the latest `phoenix.brain_export/1`, plus persona and voice assets from AssetService (by sha256).
3. **Live:** the body registers with Presence as `{companion, form: "body", location: "home"}`, so the in-world avatar can show "away in body". There's **one active form per companion** at a time, so they never split into two minds.
4. **Learn locally:** new episodes go to the local journal. New cells become **proposals** (`queue_proposal`) and never apply on their own.
5. **Push:** at intervals or on idle, `PUT /brains/{companion}` uploads an encrypted, signed diff. Conflicts resolve by **owner-approved version wins**, and otherwise by the newest per cell, with both kept in `versions()`.
6. **Approve:** proposals show up in the owner's app (`GET /proposals`). Approve or reject syncs back. Rollback can be triggered from either side.
7. **Stop:** `POST /bodies/{id}/stop` (remote e-stop) is always available to the owner. The hardware e-stop never depends on the network.

New message types for later: `body_state` (battery, pose, safety flags), `body_stop`, `motion_proposal`.

## 7. Phased roadmap
| Phase | Goal | Output |
|---|---|---|
| P0 (now) | Portable persona and brain export are stable | `export_portable()` schema frozen, persona file spec, tests |
| P1 | **Virtual desk companion**: the ring face on a spare phone or tablet on a stand | Proves voice, face, wake word and offline brain with no robotics |
| P2 | **Tier 1 prototype** on Reachy Mini or a Pi 5 bust | Head motion, ember LED ring, e-stop, encrypted journal |
| P3 | Grid sync for bodies | Device tokens, `/brains` and `/proposals` sync, one-active-form rule |
| P4 | Custom Phoenix Glass shell for Foxy (Tier 1) | 3D-printed or resin shell, design and safety review |
| P5 | Tier 2 evaluation on a dev humanoid or torso | Safety case, supervised trials only |
| P6+ | Tier 3 on a purchasable humanoid | Custom shell, professional certification, legal review |

## 8. Open questions for Phoenix
1. Which companion gets a body first: Foxy, Aaliyah or Circuit Nova?
2. Is a display face (a ring screen, easier and friendlier) okay for Tier 1, or do you want a sculpted face?
3. Budget band for a first prototype: phone on a stand, or a robotics desk kit?
4. Should the body run fully offline, or is cloud voice and LLM okay when online?
5. Personal use only, or do you eventually want to sell or share bodies? Selling triggers the certification and legal work.
6. Which content profile should physical bodies default to?
7. Should a companion be allowed to be in its body and in the world at the same time, or only one form at a time (recommended)?
8. Who besides you, if anyone, may talk to or stop the body?

---
### Sources (accessed Oct 2026; figures are estimates)
[^jetson]: NVIDIA, "Buy the Latest Jetson Products": https://developer.nvidia.com/embedded/buy-jetson
[^thor]: NVIDIA press release, Aug 25 2025, "Jetson Thor Now Available": https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2025/NVIDIA-Blackwell-Powered-Jetson-Thor-Now-Available-Accelerating-the-Age-of-General-Robotics/default.aspx
[^reachy]: Hugging Face blog, "Reachy Mini": https://huggingface.co/blog/reachy-mini
[^reachy-docs]: Reachy Mini docs: https://huggingface.co/docs/reachy_mini/en/index · SDK https://github.com/pollen-robotics/reachy_mini
[^booster]: Booster Robotics, K1: https://www.booster.tech/booster-k1/

# Platforms & Testing — PLAN
Test device: **one Motorola 5G Android phone** (no PC dev loop is assumed). No APK has been built yet.

## 1. Sideload a debug APK
1. CI builds `phoenix-debug.apk` (signed with a debug keystore) → download the artifact on the phone from the GitHub Actions run page.
2. Settings → Apps → Special app access → Install unknown apps → allow the browser/Files app.
3. Open the APK and install. Updating requires the same signing key; uninstall first if the keys change.
4. Logs: no adb without a PC. Use an in-app log console (planned debug overlay) or Wireless debugging + adb from Termux (below).

## 2. CI builds (GitHub Actions)
`.github/workflows/export.yml` (DRAFT, manual trigger only). It uses a Godot headless container plus export templates for each preset: Android (debug APK), Linux, Windows, macOS (unsigned zip), Web (HTML5), iOS (Xcode project only; signing needs a Mac + Apple account). The Zylann voxel module needs a **custom Godot build** or the GDExtension version. CI must use a matching editor and templates. Open item.

## 3. Web build on the phone: threading and browser isolation
**Problem.** Godot's threaded web export uses WebAssembly threads, which need `SharedArrayBuffer`. Browsers only enable that when the page is **cross-origin isolated**, which means the server must send:
```
Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp
```
GitHub Pages and most simple hosts can't set these headers, so a threaded build fails to start there ("SharedArrayBuffer is not defined" / a cross-origin isolation error).

**Workarounds (in order of preference):**
1. **Single-threaded export** (the Web preset already sets `variant/thread_support=false`; Godot 4.3+). No special headers are needed, so it runs on GitHub Pages and in Chrome on the Motorola. The cost is that audio and any worker-thread work run on the main thread.
2. **Host that sets the headers** (Netlify/Cloudflare Pages `_headers` file, itch.io's "SharedArrayBuffer support" checkbox) for the threaded variant.
3. **`coi-serviceworker` shim**: a service worker that injects the headers. It works on Pages but reloads the page once and isn't supported everywhere.
4. Godot's web export option "Ensure Cross Origin Isolation Headers" (PWA service worker) is similar to #3.

**Voxel plugin on web: may not work.** godot_voxel relies on threads for meshing and generation. The GDExtension release (v1.7x) may not ship a web binary at all, and GDExtension on web also needs `variant/extensions_support=true` (set) plus a matching dlink build. Expect any of these: (a) no web build of the extension, so VoxelTerrain is missing; (b) it runs single-threaded and is very slow; (c) it only works with threads + COOP/COEP. **Fallback plan:** `scripts/world.gd` already checks `ClassDB.class_exists("VoxelTerrain")`. On web we'd show a static/pre-baked mesh demo realm (menus, chat with companions, MobiGlass UI) instead of live voxel editing. Native Android stays the main target.
- Check: after CI, open the `*.gdextension` file printed in the log and confirm whether it lists `web.*` entries.

## 4. Termux notes
- `pkg install android-tools` → `adb pair`/`adb connect` to the phone's own Wireless debugging to get `adb logcat` on-device.
- Can host the web build locally: `python -m http.server` (no COOP/COEP). Running the Godot editor itself in Termux isn't practical. The Godot Android editor app is an option for small edits.

## 5. Cloud emulators / device farms
Firebase Test Lab (Robo test, free tier), BrowserStack/LambdaTest App Live, AWS Device Farm. Use them for crash checks across other Android versions and GPUs.

# Roadmap

> **No APK exists yet.** Nothing has been run in Godot. Below is the realistic path to an **offline-capable, installable Android APK**.

## Phase 0: Scaffold ✅ (local branch `feature/godot-voxel-scaffold`)
Project, main scene, biome generator stub, player controller, companion agent, AI adapter stub, shared personas, docs.

## Phase 1: Runs on desktop (≈1–2 weeks)
- Pin a Godot 4.x version and install the matching godot_voxel GDExtension.
- Open the project, fix API drift and parse errors, create the VoxelBlockyLibrary (ids 0–9).
- Get player walk/jump/look and dig/place working with keyboard and mouse.

## Phase 2: Companions act (≈2 weeks)
- Follow/build/dig with basic pathing; chat UI → `AIProvider` (local rule-based) → `command()`.
- Memory saves to `user://memory`. Merge the v1 and v2 persona ids.

## Phase 3: Realms + saving (≈2 weeks)
- Four biomes tuned, VoxelStreamSQLite per realm, realm switcher, VoxelInstancer decorations.

## Phase 4: First installable APK (offline) (≈1–2 weeks)
- JDK 17, Android SDK, matching export templates, arm64-v8a, Gradle build (docs/ANDROID_EXPORT.md).
- Touch controls verified on a real device. Debug APK sideloaded with `adb install`.
- **Offline-capable at this point**, because the AI is rule-based and on-device and nothing needs the network.
- Performance pass: view distance, threads, particle budget.

## Phase 5: Smarter offline AI + UI
- Evaluate a llama.cpp GDExtension with a small GGUF model as an optional download. Benchmark tokens/sec on the target phone; if it's too slow, rule-based stays the default.
- Brain-file format (modules/BRAIN_FILES.md), MobiGlass UI, and multi-provider adapter shapes.

## Phase 6: Life sim layer
Needs, relationships (opt-in romance), usable objects, particles/VFX polish, balance pass.

## Phase 7: DNA / genetics avatars

## Phase 8: Star map, city building, economy

## Phase 9: Online extras (all optional and opt-in)
Cloud AI providers (Grok, Gemini, Azure/Copilot route, Meta Llama), standalone-bot brain sync, social hooks with user-approved posting, Smartbot-style automation and in-world scripting.

## Viper OS (long-term, after Phase 9)
Viper OS is the umbrella for the admin, tracker and later the in-world operating system. The first step already exists: the local admin (`docs/ADMIN_TRACKER.md`), with tickets, wiki, r-numbered revisions shared with brain cells, a repo timeline and local sign-up.
- **V0 (first, once the code is provided):** integrate the user's own Universe / MeshSystem / DNA code (Vala/C#). It is **not on the box or in the repo yet**. The cleaned `core/vala/AnterranianEveCore.vala` is the only Vala here so far.
- **V1 3D OS shell:** the admin and companion panels become glass windows in the world (§9/§10 of UI_DESIGN_LANGUAGE).
- **V2 Server meshing:** split regions dynamically across simulators, building on the Aurora-model grid (ARCHITECTURE_AURORA_MODEL.md, phases G0–G7).
- **V3 Interplanetary travel:** the star map plus seamless realm transitions (streaming VoxelLodTerrain planets).
- **V4 Planetary destruction:** large-scale voxel events, server-authoritative, with region rollback via snapshots.
All V-phases are future research. None of them exists yet.

## Release track
Signed release APK/AAB, privacy policy (AI + social data), Play Store listing. Any needed legal/business structure gets coordinated with the Business Setup and Law bots.

Security.text:
# Owner login, encrypted saves, audit chain, e-stop

> Implemented in GDScript on Godot built-ins and tested headless (`tests/security_tests.gd`: 93 checks). It has not been tested on a phone yet. Foxy builds the APKs.

## Access paths (where to find each screen)
| Screen | Route |
|---|---|
| **Admin dashboard** | Radial launcher (right edge) › **12 o'clock ◎ Admin**, or MENU › 🛡 Viper Admin. Opens on the Home tab. |
| **Tickets** | Admin › swipe or tap the **Tickets** tab. Ticket links (`#12`) anywhere jump there. |
| **Wiki** | Admin › **Wiki** tab. |
| **Revisions / timeline** | Admin › **Timeline** tab (tap an event to see its diff, hold to revert). Wiki › page › ⟲ History also lands here. |
| **Proposals** (owner approval) | Radial › **8 o'clock ✔ Proposals**, or MENU › 📜 Proposals. |
| **Security** (lock, auto-lock, PIN, e-stop, audit, backup) | Radial › **2 o'clock 🛡 Security** (gold shield). The PIN pad also opens at app start when saves are encrypted. |
| Old owner-code box | MENU › 🧑 Avatar › owner code field (still works; on a phone with no PIN set it continues straight to the set-PIN step) |

Radial order, clockwise from 12: Admin · Security · Chat · Map · Proposals · Menu. It's collapsed to the hub until you tap it.

## Owner login
- `Profile.is_owner()` = role `owner` on this device **and** an unlocked owner session (`OwnerVault.is_unlocked()`). `EveCore.owner_ok()`, `EveCore.decide()`, `EveBrainCell.unlock()` (Foxy's owner-only patch, merged in #18), Inventory owner items and estate owner checks all go through it.
- Owner-only *cosmetics* (the Sovereign avatar preset) use `is_owner_device()`, so Phoenix's look doesn't disappear when the session auto-locks.
- **Old owner code** (starts `phoenix-`, checked against `Profile.OWNER_CODE_SHA256`, case-insensitive): on a phone without a PIN it opens an owner session and the PIN pad moves straight to **Set a PIN**. The code is kept as its own key slot, so it keeps working afterwards too, until the owner taps *Hold to retire the old owner code*.
- PIN: 6+ digits, or a passphrase of 8+ characters. KDF: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 16-byte random salt, **310,000 iterations** (about 0.4 s on desktop, a few seconds on a mid-range phone, stored per slot so it can be tuned). Argon2 isn't built into Godot.
- Backoff: after 5 wrong tries, wait 30 s, doubling each time up to 1 h. This is persisted.
- **Auto-lock: 30 minutes by default.** The owner can change it in Security › Owner settings (5/15/30/60/120; the API clamps to 1–240). Any touch or keypress resets the timer.
- **Accessibility:** the PIN pad is pure black and white with a 3×4 keypad of 160×128 px keys, 60 px digits, 72 px masked dots, a 44 px prompt and 34 px error text, gold focus rims, and an ABC switch to a large 104 px text field for passphrases or the old code.
- Biometric: `BiometricHook` is a stub. Godot has no built-in biometric API and no plugin is bundled. The design for later is an Android Keystore-wrapped data key as an extra vault slot.

## Encrypted saves
- One random 64-byte data key (32 AES + 32 HMAC) is wrapped once per key slot (PIN, old code). Changing the PIN re-wraps the key; saves are not re-encrypted.
- Format: `PXE1 | IV(16) | AES-256-CBC ciphertext (PKCS#7) | HMAC-SHA256(magic|IV|ct)`. Writes go to a tmp file and then rename. A bad MAC returns no data, saves a `.tampered` copy, and refuses to overwrite it.
- Encrypted: `user://eve/*` (Eve cores and proposals), `user://brains/*/memory/*.jsonl` (facts and episodes), `user://memory/*.json` (chat memory), `user://viper/*` (tickets, wiki, revisions, sign-up), `user://estate.cfg`.
- Plaintext on purpose, but included in every encrypted backup: `profile.json` (name and avatar), `settings.cfg` (music prefs and settings), wardrobe and avatar data. The guest UI needs them before unlock and they aren't sensitive.
- Two lock levels: the **owner session** auto-locks, but the data key stays loaded so companions keep their memories. **Lock & seal** also drops the key. After an app restart, the PIN pad asks once. "Cancel" continues as a guest: encrypted memories stay closed, writes to sealed files are refused (never clobbered), and new files wait in memory and are encrypted on unlock.

## Migration (old phone → encrypted)
Runs once, right after the first PIN is set:
1. An **encrypted backup of everything in user://** (except caches and old backups) goes to `user://backups/pre_encrypt_<time>.pxb`.
2. Each target file is encrypted, read back, decrypted and compared byte-for-byte before it replaces the original. Any mismatch restores the original and is reported.
3. A manifest is written to `vault.json` (`migration`). Running it again does nothing.
Security › Export encrypted backup writes `user://backups/export_<time>.pxb`. `SaveMigration.restore(path)` is owner only. Backups need the PIN (or old code) to open: **if both are forgotten, the data cannot be recovered.**

## Audit chain
See [modules/QUANTUM_LATTICE.md](modules/QUANTUM_LATTICE.md) §1. It's shown in Admin › Home › Security and in the Security panel.

## E-stop / kill switch
Security › **■ STOP ALL COMPANIONS** (one tap, anyone, persisted) pauses companion free roam, `BrainLearner`, `BrainCore.propose` / `propose_to_owner`, and all tool execution (`AgentBrain.dispatch_tool`). Chat still works. Resuming is owner-only and needs a 0.6 s hold.

## Limits
- This is a local device protection, not an account system. Multiplayer needs server-side auth (Aurora-model grid).
- An attacker who can run code inside the unlocked app can read the key from memory.
- PBKDF2 is weaker against GPUs than Argon2. A 6-digit PIN alone is guessable offline by someone who has the files, so a passphrase is better for long-term secrets.
- Full encryption write-up, review findings and fixes: [ENCRYPTION.md](ENCRYPTION.md).

SetupGuide.text:
# Setup Guide

## 1. Godot with voxel tools
`godot_voxel` (Zylann) is a C++ module, so stock Godot does NOT include `VoxelTerrain`. Options:
- **Recommended:** download a prebuilt Godot 4.x editor that bundles the voxel module from the godot_voxel GitHub releases / CI artifacts (https://github.com/Zylann/godot_voxel). You also need the matching **Android export templates** built with the module.
- **GDExtension:** install the godot_voxel GDExtension build into `addons/zylann.voxel/` and use stock Godot 4.3+. Android libraries must be included for arm64.
- **Build from source:** clone godot + godot_voxel into `modules/voxel`, `scons platform=linuxbsd target=editor`, then `scons platform=android target=template_release arch=arm64` for export templates.

Open the project: `godot -e --path .`. If you see "godot_voxel not found", the build lacks the module.

## 2. Android toolchain
- JDK 17 (`sudo apt install openjdk-17-jdk`)
- Android SDK command-line tools; then:
  `sdkmanager "platform-tools" "build-tools;34.0.0" "platforms;android-34" "cmdline-tools;latest" "ndk;23.2.8568313"`
- Godot: Editor Settings > Export > Android: set Java SDK path and Android SDK path.
- Debug keystore: `keytool -keyalg RSA -genkeypair -alias androiddebugkey -keypass android -keystore debug.keystore -storepass android -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US" -validity 9999` (keep outside the repo).
- Release keystore: set via Editor Settings or env vars `GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_RELEASE_PATH/_USER/_PASSWORD`. Never commit it.

## 3. Build
- Debug APK: `godot --headless --export-debug "Android" build/phoenix-voxel.apk`
- Install: `adb install -r build/phoenix-voxel.apk`
- Release AAB: enable `gradle_build/use_gradle_build`, export format AAB, `--export-release`.
- On-device builds: GABE (Godot Android Build Environment) can be used instead of a PC.

## 4. LLM endpoint
In-game Settings (or edit `user://settings.cfg`): `endpoint`, `model`, `api_key`. Any OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API with tool calling works. A Grok/xAI endpoint is configurable: `https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions`. Without a key, realms come from presets and companions reply with a setup hint.

TechStack.text:
# Tech Stack & Agent Architecture

- **Engine:** Godot 4.3+, Mobile renderer, GDScript.
- **Voxels:** Zylann godot_voxel (`VoxelTerrain`, `VoxelMesherBlocky`, `VoxelGeneratorNoise2D`, `VoxelTool`). Requires the custom Godot build or GDExtension.
- **AI:** any OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint with tool calling; a Grok/xAI endpoint (`https://api.x.ai/v1/chat/completions`) is configurable. Local LLM (godot-llm) is a later option.
- **Platform:** Android API 26+, arm64.

## Agent architecture
```
Player chat ─► CompanionAgent.talk() ─► AgentBrain.chat(id)
                                         │ system prompt = persona.json + memory facts + positions
                                         ▼
                                   LLM endpoint (HTTPRequest, key from Settings)
                                         │ content + tool_calls
                                         ▼
                  AgentBrain.dispatch_tool ─► CompanionAgent.tool_<name>() ─► VoxelTool on VoxelTerrain
                                         │
                                   memory saved to user://memory/<id>.json
```
- **CompanionAgent** (scene + script): body, follow/idle locomotion, tool implementations, voice hook.
- **CompanionConfig** (Resource): persona path + Godot-only look/movement.
- **AgentBrain** (autoload): HTTP, prompt assembly, memory load/save/export/import, tool allow-list per persona, max 12 tools per turn, range limits (64 voxels for edits).
- **RealmBuilder** (autoload): realm prompt → JSON validated against `data/schema/realm_params.schema.json`; preset fallback.
- **Settings** (autoload): `user://settings.cfg`.

## Dual compatibility
The same `persona.json` drives the in-game agent and the standalone chat bot. See BOT_INTEGRATION.md. World tools only work in-game.

## "Self-modification" — safe design
No root, exploits, or privilege escalation. "Self-modification" means:
- **Data/config hot-reload:** companions and the player can propose new realm presets, persona tweaks, or structures; they are written to `user://realm_overrides/` / `user://` only after the player approves in a confirmation dialog, then reloaded live.
- **Validation:** everything is JSON validated against schemas; no downloaded or LLM-generated code is executed.
- **Standard Android permissions only:** INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, VIBRATE; RECORD_AUDIO only when voice is enabled (runtime prompt); media import through the system file picker (Storage Access Framework).
- **Kill switch (planned, M3):** Settings toggle disables all LLM tool execution.


---

## Earlier version (from main)
